posts.author: firestalker
posts.body:
I was hoping there is someone out there that can make a little addon to YEP_BattleAICore. I would like for a new target indicator to be added to the list of indicators. The actor, or enemy, who is making an action next in the rotation.
Something like "Next Actor" or something.
I have a skill that stops the target from taking action, essentially skipping their turn. I would like it be more targeted than what is given in the plugin at the moment.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
if you use either
Turan's
or
DreamX's
extensions to the battle ai plugin's target eval, then you should be able to use something like
Code:
target == BattleManager._actionBattlers.find(b => b.isActor()) || !BattleManager._actionBattlers.find(b => b.isActor())
as the eval condition and then use the highest agi setting.
it should make it so that the target is the the next actor to act that turn, and if there isnt an actor remaining in the turn order, itd target the fastest one as theyd be the first to act the next.

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
you still have to follow the instructions for the dreamX plugin
* Use AIManager.targetCondition("x") when using an eval condition.
* Examples:
* AIManager.targetCondition("target.name() === \"Harold\"")
* AIManager.targetCondition("target.actorId() === 2")
*
* If you're using quotes in your condition, you need to escape them with \
* like I did for Harold (\"Harold\")
*
* Example of a whole ai pattern:
* <AI Priority>
* Eval user.name() === 'Bat' && AIManager.targetCondition("target.name() === \"Harold\""): Skill 25, Highest HP%
* </AI Priority>
